messages:
Marco: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-521. I aggregated the outstanding actions into Epic RI-10021 so we can close the loop. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-10021. Please claim an owner, paste your subtask link, and add ETA.

Anya: I'll take the alert dedupe + noise reduction item. Will create a subtask and include the current alert query and false-positive counts. ETA: 3 business days.

devon: I'll pick the staged rollback checklist update and the oncall handoff template. Can do RI-10022, ETA: 2 business days. Priya can you review the comms template?

Priya: Yep, I can review. Please include an explicit "who pings who" table for Support and PMs in the template. Also add a short verification step to the runbook.

Marco: For the recurrence RCA, we need a deeper telemetry + schedule correlation. Suggest we create a small synthetic job that mimics month-end load and run it in the Wednesday staging window. Who can own that?

Anya: I can own synthetic job creation but will need devon to hook it into our job scheduler. ETA for job + initial run: 7 business days.

devon: OK I'll wire it into the scheduler and add a note to RI-10023. I'll tag infra for capacity estimate if the run shows sustained elevated memory pressure.

ops-bot: Created JIRA RI-10022 "Rollback checklist + comms template" assigned to devon. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-10022

ops-bot: Created JIRA RI-10023 "Recurrence RCA: synthetic job + telemetry" assigned to Anya. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-10023

Marco: Proposed RACI pattern for these items: R = assignee, A = team lead owning the epic (Marco), C = SMEs (tag in ticket), I = oncall rotation. If you want a different A, say now.

Anya: Works for alert tuning. I'll add the SME list in the ticket and include the current Grafana panel links.

Priya: Small request: add an "acceptance criteria" bullet list to each subtask (PASS = smoke test, metrics stable for 48h, no pages). That will make signoff straightforward.

devon: Will do. For rollback checklist I plan to add this minimal script to verify runbook steps in staging:

```
# dry-run verification snippet
set -e
./scripts/execute_rollback_dryrun.sh --staging || exit 1
curl -sS https://staging.redwood/health || exit 1
```

Anya: When you create the alert-tuning subtask, please paste the alert rule and current alert rate trend. Example rule to start from:

alert: HighKVEvictionRate
expr: sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (node) > 100
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High KV eviction rate on {{ $labels.node }}"

Marco: If RCA ties this to scheduled jobs, tag RI-10023 with 'scheduled-job' and 'capacity-impact' so infra can supply a cost/ops runbook.

ops-bot: Epic RI-10021 updated: subtasks RI-10022, RI-10023 linked.

Priya: I'll coordinate with infra for any capacity asks but would prefer we try configuration mitigations first (eviction thresholds, backoff) before resizing. Please document cost estimate requests in the ticket so infra has context.

devon: Dropping a small note: I'll add a biweekly checkpoint on the epic and mark it for review after two successful month-end windows with no regression.

Marco: Cool. Please drop an emoji when your subtask is linked and acceptance criteria added so I can prepare the closure note for ops review.

Anya: :white_check_mark:

devon: :thumbsup:

Priya: :heavy_check_mark:
